title: Dynamic Range Sum

constraints.queries: Each query is either point update or range sum query.

input_format: The first line contains n and m. The second line contains n integers a1..an. Each of the next m lines contains either 'U x v' or 'Q l r'.
output_format: For each 'Q' query, print the sum of a[l..r].
notes: The array is mutable via point assignments.
This task is the dynamic counterpart to T03 and expects an asymptotically suitable data structure such as a Fenwick tree.
